metadata.title: Multidisciplinary Collaboration in the Performance of Aortic Surgery: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
top_takeaways: Intraoperative management of aortic surgery requires continuous, interdependent collaboration among surgeons, anesthesiologists, and perfusionists.
Aortic surgery introduces high complexity due to specialized interventions such as single-lung ventilation, systemic cooling and rewarming, and multi-organ protection.
A multidisciplinary team approach is essential to address the overlapping and immediate consequences of individual team member actions on overall patient safety.

recommendations.statement: Multidisciplinary collaboration involving surgeons, anesthesiologists, and perfusionists should be utilized to manage the high complexity and specialized interventions required during aortic surgery.
